description: Na₅AlO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbca space group. There are five inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.40 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.38 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent AlO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one AlO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.52 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.70 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.52 Å. Al is bonded to four O atoms to form AlO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Al-O bond distances ranging from 1.77-1.79 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one Al atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Al atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Al atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Al atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₅Al octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 70°.
